name: Markdown
description: Shows a Markdown file as what it says: headings, lists, tables and fenced code, with the code highlighted by language, and a switch at the top to see the source exactly as it is. **Nothing in the document is loaded or opened** -- an image is drawn as a line of text with its alt and its target rather than fetched, a link is text rather than a button, and the page never builds a path. Read-only: there is nothing here that writes.
